preconditions.description: The integer n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each value in the function f is an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(g) == n and len(h) == m and all(1 <= g[i] <= m for i in range(n)) and all(1 <= h[i] <= n for i in range(m)))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or consists of m and two lists g and h of appropriate lengths with values within specified ranges.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(g[h[i] - 1] == i + 1 for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, g(h(x)) = x for all x in [m].

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(h[g[i] - 1] == f[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, h(g(x)) = f(x) for all x in [n].
